description: This file defines repository interfaces and their implementations for interacting with a MySQL database in a backend outage management platform. It includes classes for managing customers, outages, and jobs, with methods for CRUD operations, status updates, and related data handling.

classes.name: CustomerRepository
classes.description: Implementation of ICustomerRepository for customer-related database operations.
